The Technology

Why oral strips?

01

Fast Absorption

Active ingredients bypass the digestive system and enter directly through the oral mucosa — faster onset, higher bioavailability.

02

Zero Water Required

No pills to swallow, no shaker cups to clean. Place on your tongue, let it dissolve, and you're done in seconds.

03

Precise Dosing

Every strip delivers the exact same amount. No measuring scoops, no guessing doses, no inconsistent results.
